text:
A lamp has a metal filament that glows when heated by an electric current.
The middle of the filament has a very high temperature. The ends of the filament are connected
to the base of the lamp and are cooler.
Which statement is correct?
A
Some thermal energy is conducted to the base of the lamp.
B
The filament radiates energy equally at all points along its length.
C
The lamp transfers all of the input energy as visible light.
D
When the potential difference (p.d.) across the filament is halved, the power output is halved.

options.label: A
options.text: Some thermal energy is conducted to the base of the lamp.

options.label: B
options.text: The filament radiates energy equally at all points along its length.

options.label: C
options.text: The lamp transfers all of the input energy as visible light.

options.label: D
options.text: When the potential difference (p.d.) across the filament is halved, the power output is halved.
